mentions.note: the club's 2nd oldest member in 2007; photo caption says then representing Mitcham AC
won Surrey junior cross country title; later became a Club member

photos.c: 27th January 1937---Part of Belgrave's winning team which beat U.S.M. (Paris) pose with Surrey's winning inter-county team at the Television studios, Alexandra Palace. But for our match in Paris coinciding with the inter-county championship, Carter,Penny,Footer and Cohen would have been included in the Surrey team. Belgravians are (l to r) rear row: W.L. Bayliss (President), A.R. Shaw. Centre row: C.T. Carter, A.W. Penny, J.A. Kemp, L.J. Cohen. Front row: A.E. Taylor, H.E. Footer. The central figure is, of course, J.C. Crump and the man on the extreme right, Denis Brickwood--then of Mitcham AC. Six days after these teams were televised by the Baird process, it was announced by the B.B.C. that the E.M.I. process would be adopted!

The crowd on Madeira Drive, Brighton, gasp as with just a yard or two to go Denis Brickwood, then representing Mitcham AC, overtakes Arthur Allum of Belgrave to win the National London to Brighton Road Relay by just 1 second.
